scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: The sole passing candidate forms coherent significant tumor-boundary growth and satisfies every frozen tissue, cell and joint gate.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The new tumor regions extend from existing tumor-stroma interfaces, remain connected to source tumor compartments and preserve surrounding annotated structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Sixty-one class-1 nuclei are added as complete non-overlapping instances. Mean NND changes only from 21.51 to 21.06 px and the accepted spatial and shape envelopes pass.
decisions.coupling: The nuclear additions occupy the authorized expanded tumor footprint; external-boundary binding, seam continuity and full anchor coverage all pass.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and native auxiliary structures outside joint support are preserved without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: This is mask-only, annotation-conditioned research evidence and does not establish generated-H&E realism, histologic truth or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve the sole passing candidate as the mask-condition handoff.
